_doc: Chunks for harvesting the defining vocabulary and the band-2 and band-3 candidates from model judgment. Each chunk is one request per model. 'pos' lists the part-of-speech codes the chunk is about; 'max' caps the words asked for in the defining-vocabulary pass; 'max_expand' caps the words asked for in the expansion pass.
